faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Principal Project Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Principal Project Associate position at IIT Kanpur is 10th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Principal Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field with at least 8 years of experience, or a Ph.D. in a similar field with at least 4 years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Principal Project Associate position?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Principal Project Associate post in this recruitment drive by IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Principal Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 49,000 per month, plus House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for this position must be submitted via email to the address specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Principal Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for this role will involve an online interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It contains all detailed information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Principal Project Associate at IIT Kanpur is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of this job?
faq.answer: The job is located at the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with a pincode of 208016.
